status: proposed; independent Opus/Astra review pending; no implementation or admission
selectedDesign: Explicit one-time debtor-signed native verifier activation at immutable financial genesis, then impossible maintenance authority; real lender/borrower funding via role-specific existing provider contexts; explicitly public bounded accrual
scope: Authorization/consent extension to full ledger-contract-draft only; all original financial state, effects, bounds and obligations inherited, not replaced

inheritedRequirements.requirement: Explicit funded origination and authority boundary
Authenticated financial state and actual language consumer

sourceFacts.observation: Current role capability hashes only domain/network/program/secret. Constructor accepts both secrets and payouts; a successful secret equality is not evidence of the named debtor signing terms, cap or a state head.

Current provider requires every unshielded input owner to equal its single selected payer and verifies native signatures over intent.signatureData(segment). It counts gross inputs, not only net payment.
Reservation identity includes allocation/path/account/payer/network and exact limits. Payer cannot be swapped under the same reservation record.
Native authority supports public-key committee, threshold and replay counter. Threshold greater than committee length cannot authorize an update. No new wallet identity is necessary.
Native update supports exact address, ordered updates, counter, dataToSign and addSignature. ReplaceAuthority, VerifierKeyRemove and VerifierKeyInsert are existing operations.
Maintenance signature message serializes the domain, contract address, ordered updates and counter. It does not independently serialize network, arbitrary financial state or an external receipt hash.

ContractDeploy address hashes tagged serialization of deployment, including initial state and nonce. This binds deployment state only; later mutable data is not automatically signed by signing its address.

Ledger validation requires ordered nonduplicate committee indices, valid signatures when signature validation is enabled, sufficient threshold, and replacement-authority counter equal old update counter plus one.

Application rejects stale maintenance counter; updates increment it, then carry out ordered key changes/authority replacement. Consent needs a successful finalized native update, not only locally valid signature bytes.

Existing keystore exposes getPublicKey/getAddress/signData, delegating BIP-340 operations to installed ledger-v8. Proposed consent signer uses these callbacks; no secret extraction or new key generation.

Installed SDK builds native maintenance transactions through Transaction.fromParts(networkId,...Intent.new(ttl).addMaintenanceUpdate(...)). Public helpers normally submit one maintenance operation; proposed atomic multi-update must use existing low-level native update API and submitTx.

SDK turns constructor-produced native contract state into ContractDeploy and a native transaction. Current public deployment wrapper installs generated operations; it does not expose proposed selective bootstrap deployment.
Call construction requires the operation to exist on current contract state. Native verifier availability, not a host consent Boolean, is the selected liability gate.

receiveUnshielded increases expected inputs by token/amount; it has no input-owner argument. sendUnshielded constrains recipient outputs. This source observation is corroborated by installed Effects typings; repository compiler source is not evidence of an installed compiler run.

Installed transcript Effects record expected unshielded inputs as token-to-amount, not payer-to-input ownership. Required payer equality is currently an actual-provider/comparator predicate, not a proved circuit predicate.
Current driver fixes one payer and calls initialize/accrue/settle for loan. It cannot execute a lender-funded originate or a consent setup stage without changes.
Current integration binds its wallet to firstAddress. Separate existing lender and borrower contexts and role-specific reservations are required; an address string is insufficient funding authority.
Existing now constraint checks UInt64 window overflow, blockTimeGte(now), blockTimeLt(now+300), and horizon below 2000000000. It must constrain the actual source Accrue observedTime.

Original source keeps originate/accrue/repay/settle actions. Origination terms are principal100/cap110, conversion1 scale0 none, AccrualFirst, rate1/10 floor, period60 firstPeriodStart1000; permission setup is outside these financial actions.

Current prepared deploy validates six constructor args and stores a private maintenance signing key. Proposed bootstrap must freeze selective native state before deriving address; old prepared bytes/private stores must not be edited or reused.

specifiedControls.input: Submit already signed maintenance activation before initialize.
specifiedControls.expected: It may activate keys because maintenance itself has no financial-state condition. Each financial circuit must assert initialized plus exact consented genesis at originate; consumer requires initialize finalized before signing. Early activation cannot originate debt; it may strand the instance after initialize removal and must be reported as failed setup, not silently recovered.

remainingIssues.disposition: The selected native activation solves explicit debtor consent to the frozen deployment/program. It does not add sender introspection to Compact receiveUnshielded. Lender/borrower equality is enforced by the real provider and independently observed native inputs. If required predicate is rejection by the ledger against arbitrary alternative clients, that predicate is NOT established by this design. Keep LL04.1/LL04.2 and full correspondence open until independent review accepts the bounded consumer trust boundary or supplies separately reviewed native enforcement; no weakened contract or automatic approval.

remainingIssues.classification: bounded design assumption with required controls
remainingIssues.disposition: Do not claim native maintenance signs a mutable state snapshot or network. Bind full immutable genesis and policy in deployment, freeze one-shot initialize, inspect exact current native state and chain before signing, use separate finalized setup and financial revisions. Early activation can strand setup, not create debt, if every action enforces initialized/genesis. Direct replay across mirrored chains remains a consumer-chain predicate.

Native classes and keystore callback are installed. Combined activation/filtered bootstrap/adapted observer are absent in Moriarty. Inspected Rust sources corroborate semantics but were not proved byte-equivalent to installed WASM; actual strict native verification and compiled runtime tests remain required.

Existing lender wallet access/funding has not been inspected and is not assumed. Current accounting/resource missing and stale SP01 binding still block public dispatch. Proposed seven-stage sequence and signer-specific reservations require the existing substantive resource amendment process; no numerical cap or extra attempt authorized here.
